scope: Trusted evaluator aggregate capture, export and offline verification using invented metadata only.

findings.discovery: Independent source review found that the accepted reason constructor collided with an inherited property on a plain object, producing a nonnumeric count.
findings.resolution: Author replaced inherited property lookup with Map counting and Object.fromEntries.
findings.verification: Independent test confirms repeated constructor reasons produce the numeric count 2 through export and offline verification. No pre-fix runtime reproduction is claimed.

findings.discovery: Independent source review found unverified results could declare completed sealed adjudication despite the dispatcher's non-scored outcome invariant.
findings.resolution: Author requires completed sealed adjudication exactly for correct or incorrect aggregate outcomes.
findings.verification: Independent synthetic and invented live-shaped contradictory rows both reject. No real adjudication or pre-fix runtime reproduction is claimed.

findings.discovery: Source review noted that the new output directory's parent was not fsynced after bundle creation.
findings.resolution: Author added output-directory synchronization after final permissions and parent-directory synchronization.
findings.verification: Implementation inspected and final export tests passed; no power-loss or hardware-durability experiment was performed.

independentControls: Inherited names remain numeric reason counts.
Unverified results cannot claim completed adjudication.

Only metadata columns are exported; intentionally invalid excluded detail columns are never parsed or copied.

Unknown final USD and CPU remain null while observed lower bounds survive and comparisons stay suppressed.
Cancelled and missing entries retain the full planned denominator.

testDevelopmentCorrection: The first independent run failed before exercising exporter behavior because its invented plan used a 120-second wall allowance. The test fixture was corrected to protocol v1's fixed 900 seconds; this was not a product defect.
limitations: All records, readiness assertions and live-shaped rows were invented test metadata; no real benchmark, candidate execution, provider request or billing verification occurred.
Hash and schema verification establishes internal consistency and artifact integrity, not provider authenticity.
The dispatcher database does not bind the historical executing checkout; sourceExecutionVerified remains false.
The exporter does not read or reconcile the budget ledger; known checkpoint lower bounds are not final reconciled costs.
Readiness evidence is an external trust input; the module cannot establish historical preflight timing beyond its recorded timestamp comparison.
Privileged same-UID file modification and full-bundle replacement require external digest pins and operational controls.
No source or material from the private evaluation corpus was used in these tests or this receipt.
